question: How does Shiva appear as created while remaining unimpaired in majesty?
premises: He appears as created within the sprout of his own awareness.
This appearance arises by his freedom in contemplations and other acts.
inference: Shiva can appear as created without losing his unimpaired nature because the appearance is a free manifestation within his own awareness.
uncertainties: The exact nuance of mātṛma-kura (mother-sprout) is interpretive.
plain_english: Shiva, whose majesty is never diminished, appears as if created within the sprout of his own awareness, by his freedom, in contemplations and other acts.
